text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool in this session, so please run it to confirm. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests.

- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. It is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`, or an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It is now an `int`, which also makes `age()` work.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
